author: DickyChant
body:
## Problem

`git cms-init` can report

```
You don't seem to have a personal repository, or your GitHub username (<user>) is not correct.
```

even though `<user>/cmssw` exists and is a fork of `cms-sw/cmssw`. When this happens, the `my-cmssw` remote is not added.

The check lists `https://api.github.com/users/$GITHUB_USERNAME/repos` and greps the output for `"name": "cmssw"`. That endpoint is paginated at 30 repositories per page, and only the first page is read. For users with more than 30 repositories, the fork is found only if it happens to be on the first page.

This is probably the root cause behind #54.

## Reproducer

User `DickyChant` has 205 public repositories. `DickyChant/cmssw` exists and is a fork of `cms-sw/cmssw`, but it is on page 2 of `/users/DickyChant/repos`:

```
$ curl -s https://api.github.com/users/DickyChant/repos | grep -c '"full_name"'
30
$ curl -s https://api.github.com/users/DickyChant/repos | grep -c '"name": *"cmssw"'
0
$ curl -s "https://api.github.com/users/DickyChant/repos?page=2" | grep -c '"name": *"cmssw"'
1
```

`git cms-init` in `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-29-2300` on lxplus9 then prints the warning above.

## Fix

Query `https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_USERNAME/cmssw` directly. It returns the repository when it exists and `Not Found` when it does not, so pagination no longer matters. The rest of the check (token, proxy, debug output) is unchanged.

## Testing

I ran the old and new checks in isolation against a few accounts:

| user | old check | new check |
|---|---|---|
| DickyChant (205 repos, fork on page 2) | missing | **found** |
| fwyzard (has cmssw) | found | found |
| octocat (no cmssw) | missing | missing |
| non-existent user | missing | missing |

`bash -n git-cms-init` passes. I did not run a full end-to-end `git cms-init` with the patched script.
